Payer entities (employers, Medicaid, Medicare) operate under a Fixed Maximum Allowable Annual Increase in Pharmacy Benefit Spend (MAPBS).
Prior high Net Payer Cost (NPC) for GLP-1s limited Expanded Effective Coverage Capacity (EEC) within MAPBS, leading to restricted coverage.

Manufacturers' significant reduction in NPC (e.g., $766/month -> $350/month) drastically improves the drug's Cost-Effectiveness Index (CEI), making it economically rational to cover more patients within MAPBS.
The improved CEI and lower NPC compel payer entities to expand coverage (relaxing PAs, broadening eligibility) to meet the demand for a now-affordable benefit, thereby increasing EEC.
